name: Sobha Limited
summary: Sobha Limited engages in the construction, development, sale, management, and operation of residential and commercial real estate under the Sobha brand primarily in India. It operates through the Real Estate, and Contractual and Manufacturing segments. The Real Estate segment comprises development, sale, management, and operation of townships and housing projects, as well as leasing of commercial premises. The Contractual and Manufacturing segment is involved in the development of commercial premises and other related activities, as well as manufacturing activities related to interiors, glazing, and metal works and concrete products.
